changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientproblems AS SELECT pp.id, pp.patient_id, pp.condition, pp.date_of_diagnosis, pp.condition_status, pp.type, pp.date_of_resolution, pp.by_patient, pp.source_of_information, pp.created_by, pp.created_date, pp.last_modified_by, pp.last_modified_date, pp.status, pp.cancelled_by, pp.cancelled_date, pp.cancellation_reason, pp.patient_is_free FROM public.patient_problems pp;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientproblems TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientproblems FROM report_user;
